evidence.range_scope: Exact frozen source proof/review text for its stated scope; complete internal scientific review is separate from external correctness and priority.
evidence.status: Supplied producer text only; external correctness/priority/capability UNKNOWN.

requires_external_validation.scope: Obtain external review and close precise priority gaps for the sharp tail, Pauli dual/Fourier chain, prescribed domains and weighted extension; pursue implementation only with calibrated full costs and informed comparators.
